        if (new URL(response.url()).pathname.startsWith('/api/')) event.value = JSON.parse(event.text);
      })().catch(error => evidence.recorderErrors.push({url: event.url, ...errorValue(error)})));
    });
    page.on('requestfailed', request => evidence.http.push({event: 'failed', url: request.url(),
      method: request.method(), text: request.postData(), failure: request.failure(), at: new Date().toISOString()}));
    page.on('requestfinished', request => evidence.http.push({event: 'finished', url: request.url(),
      method: request.method(), at: new Date().toISOString()}));

    phase = '初次读取及正常键盘编辑';
    const initialResponse = nextResponse('GET', '/api/work');
    await page.goto(evidence.url);
    evidence.initialResponse = await responseValue(initialResponse);
    await ready();
    const c = controls(page);
    await page.getByRole('navigation', {name: '章节', exact: true}).locator('button[data-number="2"]').click();
    await checkpoint('initial');
    await keyboardAppend(page, additions.before, evidence, 'before');
    await checkpoint('afterKeyboard');
    evidence.beforeComparison = {expected: evidence.expectedA, actual: values(evidence.states.afterKeyboard),
      matches: isDeepStrictEqual(values(evidence.states.afterKeyboard), evidence.expectedA)};
    await record();
    const comparison = nextResponse('GET', '/api/work');
    await c.reload.click();
    evidence.comparisonResponse = await responseValue(comparison);
    await ready();
    await checkpoint('beforeSave');

    phase = 'POST 等待与键盘尝试';
    // 初次读取、选章、完整 A 核对及对照结束之后才安装门。
    const post = await gate(page, /\/api\/draft(?:\?|$)/, 'POST', 'POST', evidence, gates);
    const get = await gate(page, /\/api\/work(?:\?|$)/, 'GET', 'GET读回', evidence, gates);
    await c.save.click();
    await post.wait();
    await checkpoint('postEntered');
    evidence.databaseAtPostGate = database(store, id);
    evidence.serverAtPostGate = structuredClone(evidence.serverRequests);
    await keyboardAppend(page, additions.post, evidence, 'post');
    await checkpoint('postWaiting');

    phase = '释放 POST、真实返回及 GET 等待';
    const postResponse = nextResponse('POST', '/api/draft');
    post.release();
    evidence.postResponse = await responseValue(postResponse);
    await get.wait();
    await checkpoint('getEnteredAfterPostReturned');
    evidence.databaseWhileGetWaits = database(store, id);
    await keyboardAppend(page, additions.get, evidence, 'get');
    await checkpoint('getWaiting');

    phase = '释放 GET、读回及恢复编辑';
    const readback = nextResponse('GET', '/api/work');
    get.release();
    evidence.readbackResponse = await responseValue(readback);
    await ready();
    await checkpoint('completed');
    evidence.databaseAfterSave = database(store, id);
    await keyboardAppend(page, additions.after, evidence, 'after');
    await checkpoint('editableAfterSave');

    phase = '刷新及完整存储核对';
    const refresh = nextResponse('GET', '/api/work');
    await page.reload();
    evidence.refreshResponse = await responseValue(refresh);
    await ready();
    await checkpoint('refreshed');
    evidence.databaseFinal = database(store, id);
    evidence.observationComplete = true;
  } catch (error) {
    (phase === '环境初始化' ? evidence.environmentErrors : evidence.observationErrors).push({phase, ...errorValue(error)});
  } finally {
    // 先释放两门；每个清理动作单独记录，失败也继续关闭后续资源。
    for (const g of gates) g.release();
    const cleanup = async (name, action) => {
      const item = {name, startedAt: new Date().toISOString()};
      evidence.cleanup.push(item);
      try { await bounded(Promise.resolve().then(action), name); item.passed = true; }
      catch (error) { item.passed = false; evidence.cleanupErrors.push({name, ...errorValue(error)}); }
      item.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    };
    for (const g of gates) await cleanup('路由门 ' + g.record.name, () => g.settle());
    if (page) await cleanup('撤销路由', () => page.unrouteAll({behavior: 'wait'}));
    const drain = async () => {
      while (pending.length) await Promise.all(pending.splice(0));
    };
    await cleanup('读取响应记录', drain);
    if (context) await cleanup('关闭上下文', () => context.close());
    if (browser) await cleanup('关闭浏览器', () => browser.close());
    await cleanup('收尾事件记录', drain);
    if (server?.listening) await cleanup('关闭 HTTP 服务', () => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
      server.closeAllConnections();
    }));
    if (store) await cleanup('关闭 Store', () => store.close());
    evidence.cleanupComplete = evidence.cleanupErrors.length === 0;
    evidence.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await record();
  }
}

// 时间由真实 Store 生成；其余全部字段按 fixture 和独立业务规则核对。
function withoutTimestamp(chapter) {
  const {updatedAt, ...value} = chapter;
  assert.equal(new Date(updatedAt).toISOString(), updatedAt);
  return value;
}

function verify(evidence) {
  const checks = [], errors = [];
  const check = (category, name, action) => {
    try { action(); checks.push({category, name, passed: true}); }
    catch (error) {
      checks.push({category, name, passed: false, error: errorValue(error)});
      errors.push(new Error(category + '：' + name, {cause: error}));
    }
  };
  for (const [category, field] of [
    ['环境', 'environmentErrors'], ['观察', 'observationErrors'], ['页面运行', 'pageErrors'],
    ['记录', 'recorderErrors'], ['清理', 'cleanupErrors'],
  ]) check(category, '无' + category + '错误', () => assert.deepEqual(evidence[field], []));
  check('观察', '完整观察结束', () => assert.equal(evidence.observationComplete, true));
  check('清理', '全部门已释放并收尾', () => {
    for (const g of evidence.gates) {
      assert.equal(g.released, true);
      assert.deepEqual(g.errors, []);
      if (g.entered) assert.equal(g.finished, true);
    }
    assert.equal(evidence.cleanupComplete, true);
  });
  if (!evidence.observationComplete) {
    checks.push({category: '业务', name: '未完成观察，业务结论待定', skipped: true});
    return {checks, errors};
  }

  const s = evidence.states, A = evidence.expectedA, initial = evidence.initial;
  const fixture = evidence.source.fixture, id = evidence.workId;
  const {revision, ...workSource} = fixture.work;
  const expectedWork = {...workSource, id, revision: 1};
  const expectedChapter = (number, saved = false) => ({
    workId: id, number, revision: saved ? 2 : 1,
    ...values(fixture.chapters.find(c => c.number === number)), ...(saved ? A : {}),
    status: 'draft', workRevision: 1, origin: 'human', taskId: null, threadId: null,
    previousRevisions: Array.from({length: number - 1}, (_, i) => ({number: i + 1, revision: 1})),
    reviewNote: null,
  });
  const savedChapter = chapter => assert.deepEqual(withoutTimestamp(chapter), expectedChapter(2, true));
  const httpWork = (response, saved) => {
    assert.equal(response.status, 200);
    assert.deepEqual(response.value.work, expectedWork);
    assert.deepEqual(response.value.chapters.map(c => c.number), [1, 2, 3]);
    for (const chapter of response.value.chapters) {
      const {basisCurrent, ...stored} = chapter;
      assert.equal(basisCurrent, !(saved && chapter.number === 3));
      assert.deepEqual(withoutTimestamp(stored), expectedChapter(chapter.number, saved && chapter.number === 2));
      assert.deepEqual(stored, saved && chapter.number === 2 ? evidence.postResponse.value :
        initial.chapters.find(c => c.number === chapter.number));
    }
  };
  const persisted = db => {
    const before = evidence.databaseBefore;
    assert.deepEqual(db.work, expectedWork);
    assert.deepEqual(db.chapters.map(c => c.number), [1, 2, 3]);
    savedChapter(db.chapters[1]);
    assert.deepEqual(db.chapters[1], evidence.postResponse.value);
    for (const table of ['works', 'work_versions', 'tasks']) assert.deepEqual(db.tables[table], before.tables[table]);
    assert.deepEqual(db.chapters.filter(c => c.number !== 2), initial.chapters.filter(c => c.number !== 2));
    assert.deepEqual(db.tables.chapters.filter(row => row.number !== 2), before.tables.chapters.filter(row => row.number !== 2));
    const current = db.tables.chapters.filter(row => row.number === 2);
    assert.deepEqual(current.map(row => ({work_id: row.work_id, number: row.number, revision: row.revision})),
      [{work_id: id, number: 2, revision: 2}]);
    assert.deepEqual(current[0].value, evidence.postResponse.value);
    const history = db.tables.chapter_versions;
    const newVersions = history.filter(row => row.number === 2 && row.revision === 2);
    assert.deepEqual(history.filter(row => !(row.number === 2 && row.revision === 2)), before.tables.chapter_versions);
    assert.deepEqual(newVersions, current);
  };
  const business = (name, action) => check('业务', name, action);
  business('完整作品与三章独立初始化为 r1/human/draft', () => {
    assert.deepEqual(initial.work, expectedWork);
    assert.deepEqual(initial.chapters.map(c => withoutTimestamp(c)), [1, 2, 3].map(n => expectedChapter(n)));
    assert.deepEqual(evidence.databaseBefore.work, expectedWork);
    assert.deepEqual(evidence.databaseBefore.chapters, initial.chapters);
    const tables = evidence.databaseBefore.tables;
    assert.deepEqual(tables.works.map(row => ({id: row.id, revision: row.revision, value: row.value})),
      [{id, revision: 1, value: {...workSource, id}}]);
    assert.deepEqual(tables.work_versions.map(row => ({work_id: row.work_id, revision: row.revision, value: row.value})),
      [{work_id: id, revision: 1, value: {...workSource, id}}]);
    assert.deepEqual(tables.chapters.map(row => ({work_id: row.work_id, number: row.number, revision: row.revision, value: row.value})),
      initial.chapters.map(ch => ({work_id: id, number: ch.number, revision: 1, value: ch})));
    assert.deepEqual(tables.chapter_versions, tables.chapters);
    assert.deepEqual(tables.tasks, []);
    httpWork(evidence.initialResponse, false);
  });
  business('正常键盘准确输入 A，先核对后重新读取，对照不覆盖本地 A', () => {
    assert.equal(s.initial.chapter, '第 2 章 · 当前草稿');
    assert.deepEqual(values(s.initial), values(fixture.chapters.find(c => c.number === 2)));
    assert.equal(evidence.beforeComparison.matches, true);
    assert.deepEqual(values(s.afterKeyboard), A);
    assert.deepEqual(values(s.beforeSave), A);
    assert.ok(evidence.keyboard.before.every(a => a.focused));
    assert.equal(s.beforeSave.buttons.overwrite.visible, true);
    assert.equal(s.beforeSave.comparison.body, fixture.chapters.find(c => c.number === 2).body);
    httpWork(evidence.comparisonResponse, false);
  });
  business('POST 门截到完整 A 和已读版本，尚未写入服务', () => {
    assert.deepEqual(evidence.gates[0].request.submitted, {
      workId: id, chapterNumber: 2, expectedWorkRevision: 1, expectedChapterRevision: 1,
      expectedPreviousRevisions: [{number: 1, revision: 1}], ...A,
    });
    assert.deepEqual(values(s.postEntered), A);
    assert.deepEqual(evidence.serverAtPostGate.filter(r => r.method === 'POST'), []);
    assert.deepEqual(evidence.databaseAtPostGate, evidence.databaseBefore);
  });
  for (const [phase, key] of [['postWaiting', 'post'], ['getWaiting', 'get']]) {
    business(phase + ' 每次正常键盘尝试均不能改变完整 A', () => {
      assert.deepEqual(values(s[phase]), A);
      assert.deepEqual(evidence.keyboard[key].map(a => a.field), ['title', 'body']);
      for (const attempt of evidence.keyboard[key]) {
        assert.deepEqual(values(attempt.before), A);
        assert.deepEqual(values(attempt.after), A);
        assert.equal(attempt.focused, false);
        assert.deepEqual(attempt.actions, ['locator.focus()', 'keyboard.press(Control+End)', 'keyboard.type(上述原文)']);
      }
    });
    business(phase + ' 暂停章名、正文及可见覆盖入口', () => {
      assert.equal(s[phase].titleEditable, false);
      assert.equal(s[phase].bodyEditable, false);
      assert.equal(s[phase].buttons.overwrite.visible, true);
      for (const button of ['save', 'reload', 'read', 'overwrite']) assert.equal(s[phase].buttons[button].enabled, false);
    });
  }
  business('POST 真实返回完整 human/draft r2，GET 门中服务已有完整 A/历史', () => {
    assert.equal(evidence.postResponse.status, 200);
    savedChapter(evidence.postResponse.value);
    assert.equal(evidence.gates[1].entered, true);
    assert.deepEqual(values(s.getEnteredAfterPostReturned), A);
    persisted(evidence.databaseWhileGetWaits);
  });
  business('真实 GET 读回与页面完整 A 一致', () => {
    httpWork(evidence.readbackResponse, true);
    assert.deepEqual(values(s.completed), A);
    assert.match(s.completed.status, /已保存.*读回/);
    persisted(evidence.databaseAfterSave);
  });
  business('读回完成后恢复章名/正文编辑，补记只留本地', () => {
    assert.ok(s.completed.titleEditable && s.completed.bodyEditable);
    assert.ok(s.completed.buttons.reload.enabled && s.completed.buttons.read.enabled && s.completed.buttons.overwrite.enabled);
    assert.ok(evidence.keyboard.after.every(a => a.focused));
    assert.deepEqual(values(s.editableAfterSave), append(A, additions.after));
    assert.equal(s.editableAfterSave.buttons.save.enabled, true);
  });
  business('刷新真实 GET、页面、五表与全部历史只保留 A，其他对象原样', () => {
    httpWork(evidence.refreshResponse, true);
    assert.deepEqual(values(s.refreshed), A);
    persisted(evidence.databaseFinal);
    assert.deepEqual(evidence.databaseFinal, evidence.databaseAfterSave);
    assert.deepEqual(evidence.serverRequests.filter(r => r.method === 'POST').map(r => ({url: r.url, status: r.status})),
      [{url: '/api/draft', status: 200}]);
    for (const g of evidence.gates) assert.equal(g.action, 'continue');
  });
  return {checks, errors};
}

function connectSession(label) {
  const events = [], calls = [];
  let stderr = '', closedResolve;
  const closed = new Promise(resolveClosed => {closedResolve = resolveClosed;});
  const transport = new StdioClientTransport({command: process.execPath, args: [resolve('dist/mcp-two-tools.js'), dbPath], stderr: 'pipe'});
  const client = new Client({name: 'novel-two-tools-experiment', version: '0.1.0'});
  transport.stderr?.on('data', bytes => {stderr += bytes.toString('utf8');});
  const record = (type, value) => events.push({time: new Date().toISOString(), type, ...value});
  const send = transport.send.bind(transport);
  transport.send = async (message, options) => {record('send', {message}); return send(message, options);};
  transport.onmessage = message => record('receive', {message});
  transport.onclose = () => {record('transport.closed', {pid: transport.pid}); closedResolve();};
  transport.onerror = error => record('transport.error', {message: error.message});
  return {
    client, transport, closed, record, calls,
    async open() {
      record('connect.start', {});
      await client.connect(transport);
      record('connect.end', {pid: transport.pid, version: client.getServerVersion(), capabilities: client.getServerCapabilities()});
    },
    async call(name, args) {
      try {
        const returned = await client.callTool({name, arguments: args});
        calls.push({name, arguments: args, returned});
        return returned;
      } catch (error) {
        calls.push({name, arguments: args, thrown: {name: error.name, message: error.message, code: error.code ?? null}});
        throw error;
      }
    },
    async close() {
      record('close.start', {pid: transport.pid});
      await client.close();
      record('close.end', {pid: transport.pid});
      await write(`${label}-协议.json`, events);
      await write(`${label}-调用.json`, calls);
      await writeFile(resolve(runDir, `${label}-stderr.txt`), stderr, 'utf8');
      assert.equal(transport.pid, null);
    },
  };
}

    try{

    }catch(error){

    }
  });
}

import {DatabaseSync} from 'node:sqlite';
import {mkdirSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname} from 'node:path';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {LabError,type WorkInput,type DraftInput} from './schemas.js';

export type Work=WorkInput & {revision:number};
export type Chapter={workId:string;number:number;revision:number;title:string;body:string;status:'draft'|'adopted';workRevision:number;origin:'human'|'agent';taskId:string|null;threadId:string|null;updatedAt:string;previousRevisions?:{number:number;revision:number}[];reviewNote?:string|null};
export type Task={id:string;workId:string;chapterNumber:number;threadId:string|null;state:'created'|'running'|'completed'|'failed'|'cancelled'|'interrupted';codeVersion:string;createdAt:string;updatedAt:string;error:string|null;usage:unknown};

export class Store {
  readonly db:DatabaseSync;
  constructor(path:string){
    if(path!==':memory:')mkdirSync(dirname(path),{recursive:true});
    this.db=new DatabaseSync(path,{timeout:2000});
    this.db.exec(`
      PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS works(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS work_versions(work_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES works(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(work_id,revision)) STRICT;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chapters(work_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES works(id), number INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(work_id,number)) STRICT;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chapter_versions(work_id TEXT NOT NULL, number INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(work_id,number,revision), FOREIGN KEY(work_id,number) REFERENCES chapters(work_id,number)) STRICT;
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, content TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT;
    `);
  }
  close(){this.db.close();}
  private transaction<T>(action:()=>T):T{
    // 读取基线与写入处于同一事务，两个入口不能越过修订检查。
    this.db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');
    try{const result=action();this.db.exec('COMMIT');return result;}
    catch(error){this.db.exec('ROLLBACK');throw error;}
  }
  init(input:WorkInput):Work{
    if(this.db.prepare('SELECT id FROM works WHERE id=?').get(input.id))throw new LabError('WORK_EXISTS','作品已存在，初始化不会覆盖它。');
    if(input.outline.some((item,index)=>item.number!==index+1))throw new LabError('OUTLINE_ORDER','大纲章节必须从 1 开始连续排列。');
    return this.transaction(()=>{
      const content=JSON.stringify(input);
      this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO works VALUES(?,?,?)').run(input.id,1,content);
      this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO work_versions VALUES(?,?,?)').run(input.id,1,content);
      return {...input,revision:1};
    });
  }
  getWork(id:string):Work{
    const row=this.db.prepare('SELECT revision,content FROM works WHERE id=?').get(id);
    if(!row)throw new LabError('WORK_NOT_FOUND',`没有作品 ${id}，先初始化。`);
    return {...JSON.parse(row.content as string),revision:Number(row.revision)};
  }
  listWorks():Work[]{
    return this.db.prepare('SELECT revision,content FROM works ORDER BY id').all().map(row=>({...JSON.parse(row.content as string),revision:Number(row.revision)}));
  }
  getChapter(workId:string,number:number):Chapter|null{
    this.getWork(workId);
    return this.findChapter(workId,number);
  }
  private findChapter(workId:string,number:number):Chapter|null{
    const row=this.db.prepare('SELECT content FROM chapters WHERE work_id=? AND number=?').get(workId,number);
    return row?JSON.parse(row.content as string):null;
  }
  updateWork(input:WorkInput,expectedRevision:number):Work{
    return this.transaction(()=>{
      const current=this.getWork(input.id);
      if(current.revision!==expectedRevision)throw new LabError('STALE_WORK',`要求已是 r${current.revision}，请重读后再修改。`);
      if(input.outline.some((item,index)=>item.number!==index+1))throw new LabError('OUTLINE_ORDER','大纲章节必须从 1 开始连续排列。');
      const saved=this.db.prepare('SELECT number FROM chapters WHERE work_id=?').all(current.id);
      if(saved.some(row=>!input.outline.some(item=>item.number===row.number)))throw new LabError('OUTLINE_HAS_SAVED_CHAPTER','大纲不能静默移除已保存的章节。');
      const revision=current.revision+1;
      // 改写前保存当前原始资料，修订引用有实际文本可回查。
      this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO work_versions SELECT id,revision,content FROM works WHERE id=? ON CONFLICT(work_id,revision) DO NOTHING').run(current.id);
      const content=JSON.stringify(input);
      this.db.prepare('UPDATE works SET revision=?,content=? WHERE id=?').run(revision,content,current.id);
      this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO work_versions VALUES(?,?,?)').run(current.id,revision,content);
      return {...input,revision};
    });
  }
  getWorkVersion(id:string,revision:number):Work{
    this.getWork(id);
    const row=this.db.prepare('SELECT content FROM work_versions WHERE work_id=? AND revision=?').get(id,revision);
    if(!row)throw new LabError('WORK_VERSION_NOT_FOUND','没有保存这个资料修订。');
    return {...JSON.parse(row.content as string),revision};
  }
  private persistChapter(chapter:Chapter):Chapter{
    const content=JSON.stringify(chapter);
    this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO chapters VALUES(?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(work_id,number) DO UPDATE SET revision=excluded.revision,content=excluded.content').run(chapter.workId,chapter.number,chapter.revision,content);
    this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO chapter_versions VALUES(?,?,?,?)').run(chapter.workId,chapter.number,chapter.revision,content);
    return chapter;
  }
  listChapters(workId:string):Omit<Chapter,'body'>[]{
    this.getWork(workId);
    const rows=this.db.prepare('SELECT content FROM chapters WHERE work_id=? ORDER BY number').all(workId);
    return rows.map(row=>{const {body,...chapter}=JSON.parse(row.content as string) as Chapter;return chapter;});
  }
  saveDraft(input:DraftInput,origin:'human'|'agent',taskId:string|null=null):Chapter{
    return this.transaction(()=>{
      const work=this.getWork(input.workId);
      if(work.revision!==input.expectedWorkRevision)throw new LabError('STALE_WORK',`要求已是 r${work.revision}，请重读后再保存。`);
      if(!work.outline.some(item=>item.number===input.chapterNumber))throw new LabError('CHAPTER_OUT_OF_SCOPE','本章不在当前已确认的大纲中。');
      const current=this.findChapter(work.id,input.chapterNumber);
      if((current?.revision??0)!==input.expectedChapterRevision)throw new LabError('STALE_CHAPTER',`正文已是 r${current?.revision??0}，请重读后合并。`);
      const bases=[...input.expectedPreviousRevisions].sort((a,b)=>a.number-b.number);
      if(bases.length!==input.chapterNumber-1||bases.some((item,index)=>item.number!==index+1))throw new LabError('PREVIOUS_BASES_REQUIRED','需要逐项提供前面全部章节的当前修订。');
      for(const base of bases){
        const previous=this.findChapter(work.id,base.number);
        if(!previous)throw new LabError('PREVIOUS_CHAPTER_MISSING',`第 ${base.number} 章尚未保存。`);
        if(previous.revision!==base.revision)throw new LabError('STALE_PREVIOUS',`第 ${base.number} 章已经是 r${previous.revision}，请读取当前正文后再续写。`);
      }
      const task=taskId?this.getTask(taskId):null;
      if(task&&(task.workId!==work.id||task.chapterNumber!==input.chapterNumber))throw new LabError('TASK_MISMATCH','任务与本章不一致。');
      const chapter:Chapter={workId:work.id,number:input.chapterNumber,revision:(current?.revision??0)+1,title:input.title,body:input.body,status:'draft',workRevision:work.revision,origin,taskId,threadId:task?.threadId??null,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),previousRevisions:bases,reviewNote:null};
      return this.persistChapter(chapter);
    });
  }
  adopt(workId:string,number:number,expectedRevision:number,note:string):Chapter{
    return this.transaction(()=>{
      const work=this.getWork(workId);
      const current=this.findChapter(work.id,number);
      if(!current)throw new LabError('CHAPTER_NOT_FOUND','还没有该章正文。');
      if(current.revision!==expectedRevision)throw new LabError('STALE_CHAPTER',`正文已是 r${current.revision}，不能采用旧版本。`);
      return this.persistChapter({...current,revision:current.revision+1,status:'adopted',origin:'human',reviewNote:note,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
    });
  }
  exportWork(id:string){
    const work=this.getWork(id);
    const rows=this.db.prepare('SELECT content FROM chapters WHERE work_id=? ORDER BY number').all(id);
    const chapters=rows.map(row=>JSON.parse(row.content as string) as Chapter);
    const details=chapters.map(chapter=>{
      if(chapter.number>1)assert(chapter.previousRevisions,'连续章节缺少保存时的前文基线');
      const previousChanged=(chapter.previousRevisions??[]).some(base=>this.findChapter(id,base.number)?.revision!==base.revision);
      return {number:chapter.number,revision:chapter.revision,status:chapter.status,workRevision:chapter.workRevision,previousRevisions:chapter.previousRevisions??[],reviewNote:chapter.reviewNote??null,basisCurrent:chapter.workRevision===work.revision&&!previousChanged};
    });
    const text=`# ${work.title}\n\n用途：${work.purpose}\n\n`+chapters.map((chapter,index)=>`## 第 ${chapter.number} 章 ${chapter.title}\n\n状态：${chapter.status}，正文 r${chapter.revision}；${details[index].basisCurrent?'资料基线一致，品质仍需人判断':'资料有变动，需重新核对'}。\n\n${chapter.reviewNote?`采用说明：${chapter.reviewNote}\n\n`:''}${chapter.body}\n`).join('\n');
    return {workId:id,workRevision:work.revision,expectedChapters:work.outline.length,savedChapters:chapters.length,allOutlineChaptersSaved:chapters.length===work.outline.length&&chapters.every((chapter,index)=>chapter.number===index+1),chapters:details,text};
  }
  createTask(input:Pick<Task,'id'|'workId'|'chapterNumber'|'codeVersion'>):Task{
    const work=this.getWork(input.workId);
    if(!work.outline.some(item=>item.number===input.chapterNumber))throw new LabError('CHAPTER_OUT_OF_SCOPE','任务章节不在大纲中。');
    const now=new Date().toISOString();
    const task:Task={...input,threadId:null,state:'created',createdAt:now,updatedAt:now,error:null,usage:null};
    this.db.prepare('INSERT INTO tasks VALUES(?,?)').run(task.id,JSON.stringify(task));return task;
  }
  getTask(id:string):Task{
    const row=this.db.prepare('SELECT content FROM tasks WHERE id=?').get(id);
    if(!row)throw new LabError('TASK_NOT_FOUND','任务记录不存在。');return JSON.parse(row.content as string);
  }
  updateTask(id:string,change:Partial<Pick<Task,'threadId'|'state'|'error'|'usage'>>):Task{
    const task={...this.getTask(id),...change,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
    this.db.prepare('UPDATE tasks SET content=? WHERE id=?').run(JSON.stringify(task),id);return task;
  }
}

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {mkdtempSync,readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';

import {once} from 'node:events';

import {Store,type Chapter} from '../store.js';

test('两个 HTTP 编辑者不能用旧修订覆盖已保存正文，重读与 CLI/Store 一致',async()=>{
  const archive=JSON.parse(readFileSync('fixtures/three-chapter-archive.json','utf8'));
  const store=new Store(join(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'novel-prototype-')),'fixture.sqlite'));
  const id='prototype-'+randomUUID();const work=store.init(workInput.parse({...archive.work,id}));
  const chapters:Chapter[]=[];for(const c of archive.chapters){chapters.push(store.saveDraft(draftInput.parse({workId:id,chapterNumber:c.number,expectedWorkRevision:work.revision,expectedChapterRevision:0,expectedPreviousRevisions:chapters.map(p=>({number:p.number,revision:p.revision})),title:c.title,body:c.body}),'human'));}
  const server=prototypeServer(store,id);server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(server,'listening');const address=server.address();assert(address&&typeof address!=='string');const base='http://127.0.0.1:'+address.port;
  try{
    const before=await(await fetch(base+'/api/work?work='+id)).json();assert.deepEqual(before.chapters.map((c:{body:string})=>c.body),archive.chapters.map((c:{body:string})=>c.body));
    const input={workId:id,chapterNumber:2,expectedWorkRevision:1,expectedChapterRevision:1,expectedPreviousRevisions:[{number:1,revision:1}],title:chapters[1].title,body:chapters[1].body+'\n\n人工修改：林澈停下来再听一次。'};
    const a=await fetch(base+'/api/draft',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(input)});assert.equal(a.status,200);const saved=await a.json();assert.equal(saved.revision,2);assert.equal(saved.origin,'human');assert.equal(saved.taskId,null);
    const b=await fetch(base+'/api/draft',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({...input,body:'旧窗口的修改不能覆盖'})});assert.equal(b.status,409);assert.equal((await b.json()).error.code,'STALE_CHAPTER');
    const after=await(await fetch(base+'/api/work?work='+id)).json();assert.equal(after.chapters[1].body,input.body);assert.equal(after.chapters[1].revision,2);assert.equal(after.chapters[2].basisCurrent,false);assert.deepEqual(store.getChapter(id,2),saved);
    const invalid=await fetch(base+'/api/draft',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({...input,body:''})});assert.equal(invalid.status,400);assert.equal((await invalid.json()).error.code,'INVALID_INPUT');
  }finally{await new Promise<void>((resolve,reject)=>server.close(error=>error?reject(error):resolve()));store.close();}
});

import {test} from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {mkdtemp,readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';
import {resolve} from 'node:path';
import {Store} from '../store.js';
import {workInput,LabError} from '../schemas.js';

test('真实保存可重开读取；人的修改令旧提议失效',async()=>{
  const directory=await mkdtemp(resolve(tmpdir(),'agent-lab-state-'));
  const db=resolve(directory,'novel.sqlite');
  const seed=workInput.parse(JSON.parse(await readFile('seed/钟楼.json','utf8')));
  const store=new Store(db);
  store.init(seed);
  const input={workId:seed.id,chapterNumber:1,expectedWorkRevision:1,expectedChapterRevision:0,expectedPreviousRevisions:[],title:'人工测试章节',body:'这段人工文字仅用于验证存储，不是模型生成。'};
  const first=store.saveDraft(input,'agent');
  assert.equal(first.status,'draft');
  store.close();
  const reopened=new Store(db);
  assert.equal(reopened.getChapter(seed.id,1)?.body,input.body);
  const edited=reopened.saveDraft({...input,expectedChapterRevision:1,body:'人修改后的有效正文。'},'human');
  assert.equal(edited.revision,2);
  assert.throws(()=>reopened.saveDraft({...input,expectedChapterRevision:1,body:'旧提议覆盖人的修改。'},'agent'),error=>error instanceof LabError&&error.code==='STALE_CHAPTER');
  assert.equal(reopened.getChapter(seed.id,1)?.body,'人修改后的有效正文。');
  assert.equal(reopened.db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM chapter_versions').get()?.count,2);
  reopened.close();
});

A.title: 墙后的声音 · 保存前补记
A.body:
周伯侧过脸，等影子的尖端又擦过砖缝，才点了一下头。

“听见了。像轮齿碰了一下。”

林澈慢慢松开铜摆。摆锤仍垂在地板那颗钉子上方，墙上的影子却照旧往返。他擦掉掌心的汗，翻开笔记，把刚才看见、听见的事分成两行写下。写到声音的位置时，笔尖停住了。隔着砖墙，他还不能断定里面是什么。

他来这里是查看停钟的，师父还等着他带回故障的消息。眼前的齿轮没有坏处可认，墙后却有东西在响。林澈合上笔记，请周伯留在窗边，替他看着影子，自己绕过木架，贴近那面墙。

下一记轻响来时，他正把耳朵抵在砖缝旁。声音从左下方传来，短得像指甲擦过梳齿。他蹲低了一些，避开横梁，听完两个来回，才伸手摸向梁后的墙面。

指腹碰到一块冰凉的铁片。

那里积着厚灰，铁片又被横梁遮住，从钟室中央几乎看不见。林澈用袖口擦出它的边缘：巴掌宽的一块盖板，四角各有一颗螺丝。底边一道窄缝里，露着半截干枯的蛛丝。

“这里以前打开过吗？”

周伯弯腰看了看。“我没动过。平常上来，只在外面照看钟。”

林澈把螺丝刀拿出来，先在掌心转了转，没有立即落到螺丝上。他向周伯说明，自己只想看看盖板后面是否有传动杆，若碰见认不出的东西，就停手。老人挪到横梁另一侧，给他让出蹲身的位置。

第一颗螺丝很紧。林澈压住刀柄，肩膀抵着木架，稍稍加力，终于把它转松。铁盖随之一震，墙里那声轻响恰好传来。他立刻停下，抬头看周伯。

“影子刚过去。”周伯说。

林澈等了一会儿。手上的螺丝刀没有再动，声音仍按原来的间隔响起。他这才继续，逐颗取下螺丝，放进工具箱的浅格里。最后一颗退出时，他托住铁盖，免得它落下。

墙里露出一个浅洞。洞口上沿有一道旧油痕，里面横着一截细轴，比钟架上的轴细得多。一根褪色的红线绕在轴上，末端垂下来，离洞底只有一指宽。

轻响再来，红线颤了一下。

林澈凑近，想看清它怎样动，额头却碰到了横梁。他往后缩，重新蹲稳。周伯扶着梁，也俯下身。两人都没有说话，只看见红线在下一次轻响时又抖动了一下。

“是这儿响？”周伯问。

“至少这里也有东西在动。”

林澈沿着细轴往里看，轴的两端都埋进砖里，洞口太窄，看不到轮齿。他再转头望向停住的钟架。露在外面的杆件，没有一根伸向这个洞；可藏在墙里的部分怎样连接，他不知道。

他把铁盖放到地上，在笔记里画出洞口和细轴，又用铅笔在洞壁上点了一处记号，正对红线垂下的位置。刚才那两下太轻，他还没看清细轴是转过一点，还是只在震动。

“还拆吗？”周伯问。

林澈收起螺丝刀，将灯留在原处。

“先看清它下一次怎么动。”

周伯重新望向墙面。影子的尖端正缓缓接近那道砖缝，林澈蹲在洞口前，等着红线和石壁上的小点再次相遇。

保存前补记：林澈把观察时间写在页边。
